sentence: The manager ____ the report before the meeting started.
explain: Hành động xảy ra trước một mốc quá khứ (the meeting started) → quá khứ đơn 'reviewed'.

sentence: All employees must submit ____ timesheets by Friday.
explain: Trước danh từ 'timesheets' cần tính từ sở hữu 'their'.

sentence: The new software is ____ easier to use than the old version.
explain: 'much' nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn (much easier). 'very' không đi với so sánh hơn.

sentence: Ms. Park has worked at the company ____ 2015.
explain: Hiện tại hoàn thành + mốc thời gian → 'since 2015'.

sentence: Please contact the front desk ____ you need assistance.
explain: Mệnh đề điều kiện: 'if you need assistance'.

sentence: The shipment will arrive ____ Monday morning.
explain: Ngày trong tuần đi với giới từ 'on'.

sentence: Neither the director nor the assistants ____ available today.
explain: Với 'neither… nor', động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất (the assistants) → 'are'.

sentence: The company ____ its annual sales conference in Singapore next month.
Applicants are required to have ____ three years of experience.
explain: 'at least three years' = ít nhất ba năm — yêu cầu tối thiểu.

sentence: The office will be closed ____ the renovation.
explain: 'during' + danh từ (the renovation). 'while' phải đi với mệnh đề.

sentence: The ____ of the new branch has been delayed until spring.
explain: Sau 'The' và trước 'of' cần danh từ → 'opening'.

sentence: Customers who purchase online can ____ return items in store.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'return' cần trạng từ 'easily'.

sentence: The results were ____ than we had expected.
Employees ____ in the training session should register by Tuesday.
explain: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: employees (who are) interested in…

sentence: The technician fixed the printer ____.
explain: Đại từ phản thân nhấn mạnh 'tự mình' → 'himself'.

sentence: We look forward to ____ from you soon.
____ the heavy rain, the outdoor event went ahead as planned.
explain: 'Despite' + cụm danh từ (the heavy rain). 'Although' cần mệnh đề.

sentence: The invoice must be paid ____ 30 days of receipt.
Ms. Lee is responsible ____ coordinating the marketing campaign.
The board ____ to approve the merger at yesterday's meeting.
If the package ____ damaged, please contact customer service.
explain: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn; chủ ngữ số ít → 'arrives'.

sentence: The hotel offers free breakfast to ____ guest.
explain: 'guest' số ít → 'every guest'. 'all/most/many' đi với danh từ số nhiều.

sentence: Sales have increased ____ since the new store opened.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho 'have increased' cần trạng từ 'steadily'.

sentence: The seminar was ____ well attended that extra chairs were needed.
Please make sure that the documents ____ before you leave.
explain: Tài liệu 'được ký' → bị động 'are signed'.

sentence: The CEO, ____ founded the company in 1998, will retire next year.
explain: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ của 'founded' → 'who'.

sentence: We have ____ received the samples from the supplier.
explain: 'already' trong câu khẳng định hiện tại hoàn thành. 'yet' dùng phủ định/nghi vấn.

sentence: The safety inspection is conducted ____ six months.
explain: 'every six months' = sáu tháng một lần.

sentence: The new policy applies to full-time employees ____.
explain: 'only' đứng cuối câu nhấn mạnh 'chỉ' nhân viên toàn thời gian.

sentence: By the time the guests arrive, the caterers ____ the tables.
explain: 'By the time + hiện tại' → tương lai hoàn thành 'will have set'.

sentence: The hotel is ____ located near the airport and the city center.
explain: 'conveniently located' = ở vị trí thuận tiện.

sentence: Please ____ your seat belt while the sign is on.
explain: Cụm cố định 'fasten your seat belt' = thắt dây an toàn.

sentence: The company reported a 12 percent ____ in profits last quarter.
explain: 'increase in profits' = mức tăng lợi nhuận; đi với số phần trăm.

sentence: Ms. Tran will ____ the meeting because the director is away.
explain: 'chair the meeting' = chủ trì cuộc họp.

sentence: All products come with a two-year ____.
explain: 'warranty' = bảo hành; đi với thời hạn (two-year).

sentence: Employees must ____ with the new security regulations.
explain: 'comply with' = tuân thủ. 'obey/accept' không đi với 'with'.

sentence: The flight was ____ due to bad weather.
We ____ your patience while we resolve the issue.
explain: 'appreciate your patience' = cảm ơn bạn đã kiên nhẫn.

sentence: The ____ for the position must be submitted online.
explain: 'application' = hồ sơ ứng tuyển. 'applicant' là người, 'appliance' là thiết bị.

sentence: The restaurant can ____ up to 200 guests for private events.
Please keep your ____ as proof of purchase.
explain: 'receipt' = biên lai. Đừng nhầm với 'recipe' (công thức nấu ăn).

sentence: The factory has ____ its production capacity by 30 percent.
Our team will ____ a survey to measure customer satisfaction.
explain: 'conduct a survey' = tiến hành khảo sát.

sentence: The contract will ____ at the end of December unless renewed.
The new intern is very ____ and always meets her deadlines.
explain: 'reliable' = đáng tin cậy — hợp với 'always meets her deadlines'.

sentence: Please ____ the attached form and return it to HR.
explain: 'complete the form' = điền đầy đủ biểu mẫu.

sentence: The museum offers a 20% ____ to students with a valid ID.
The meeting has been ____ to next Thursday.
All visitors must ____ at the reception desk upon arrival.
explain: 'register at reception' = đăng ký tại quầy lễ tân.

sentence: The quarterly report ____ a summary of all regional sales.
explain: 'includes a summary' = bao gồm phần tóm tắt.

sentence: Because of high demand, the item is temporarily out of ____.
The supplier agreed to ____ the price by five percent.
Ms. Kim was ____ to regional manager last month.
The bank charges a small ____ for international transfers.
explain: 'fee' = phí dịch vụ. 'fare' là tiền vé, 'fine' là tiền phạt.

sentence: We need to ____ a venue for the year-end party.
The manual provides step-by-step ____ for installing the software.
Our customer service team is ____ 24 hours a day.
explain: 'available 24 hours' = sẵn sàng phục vụ 24 giờ.

sentence: The new machine will help us ____ waste and save energy.
Please ____ me know if the delivery date changes.
The hotel received excellent ____ from guests for its friendly staff.
The report ____ by the finance team every Friday.
explain: Báo cáo 'được chuẩn bị' → bị động hiện tại đơn 'is prepared'.

sentence: Ms. Cho ____ the client when the power went out.
explain: Hành động đang diễn ra thì bị chen ngang → quá khứ tiếp diễn 'was calling'.

sentence: Please return the signed form ____ Wednesday.
explain: 'by + mốc thời gian' = trước hoặc đúng hạn. 'until' chỉ kéo dài tới.

sentence: The hotel is ____ the train station, so guests can walk there.
explain: 'near + danh từ' không cần giới từ. 'next to', 'close to', 'beside' mới đúng.

sentence: Employees ____ wish to attend must register in advance.
explain: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ của 'wish' → 'who'.

sentence: The new printer works much more ____ than the old one.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'works' cần trạng từ; 'more efficiently' là so sánh hơn.

sentence: ____ of the two proposals was accepted by the board.
explain: Hai lựa chọn → 'Neither of the two'. 'None' dùng cho từ ba trở lên.

sentence: Mr. Okafor has ____ finished the quarterly analysis.
explain: Hiện tại hoàn thành khẳng định → 'already'.

sentence: The manager asked us ____ the meeting room after use.
Sales figures for March were ____ higher than expected.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ so sánh 'higher' cần trạng từ 'slightly'.

sentence: The warehouse ____ renovated at the moment, so deliveries are delayed.
explain: 'at the moment' → hiện tại tiếp diễn bị động 'is being renovated'.

sentence: We will refund the full amount ____ the item is returned unused.
explain: 'provided that' = với điều kiện là. 'unless' = trừ khi (ngược nghĩa).

sentence: The keynote speech was ____ by more than 500 attendees.
Ms. Ito is one of the ____ experienced engineers in the company.
explain: 'one of the most + adj' = một trong những … nhất.

sentence: Our office will be closed on Monday ____ the national holiday.
explain: 'because of + cụm danh từ'. 'because/since/as' cần mệnh đề.

sentence: The technician recommended ____ the software before installing updates.
The candidate ____ we interviewed yesterday has accepted the offer.
explain: Chỉ người, làm tân ngữ của 'interviewed' → 'who' (hoặc 'whom').

sentence: Prices are expected to rise ____ 5 percent next year.
explain: 'rise by + mức tăng'. 'rise to' = tăng tới mức.

sentence: ____ arriving at the airport, please proceed to the check-in counter.
explain: 'Upon + V-ing' = ngay khi. 'While' cần mệnh đề đầy đủ.

sentence: The company has grown ____ over the past decade.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho 'has grown' cần trạng từ 'considerably'.

sentence: Had the shipment arrived on time, we ____ the deadline.
explain: Câu điều kiện loại 3 đảo ngữ 'Had + S + V3' → 'would have met'.

sentence: Please keep this document ____ for your records.
The new branch will open ____ the end of the year.
Mr. Reyes ____ to Berlin twice this year for trade shows.
explain: 'this year' chưa kết thúc + số lần → hiện tại hoàn thành.

sentence: Visitors are not allowed to enter the laboratory ____ an escort.
The larger the order, ____ the discount.
explain: So sánh kép 'The + so sánh hơn, the + so sánh hơn'.

sentence: Ms. Alvarez will be out of the office ____ next Friday.
explain: 'until + mốc' = cho đến (thứ Sáu tuần sau mới về).

sentence: All staff are required to wear ____ identification badges.
explain: Tính từ sở hữu trước danh từ 'badges'.

sentence: The seminar on digital marketing was ____ informative.
Once the contract ____, work can begin immediately.
explain: Mệnh đề thời gian 'once' dùng hiện tại; hợp đồng 'được ký' → bị động.

sentence: The museum offers guided tours ____ English and Japanese.
explain: 'tours in + ngôn ngữ'; 'in both A and B'.

sentence: We apologize for ____ inconvenience this may cause.
explain: Câu xin lỗi chuẩn: 'any inconvenience this may cause'.

sentence: The product launch, ____ was scheduled for May, has been moved to July.
explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) chỉ vật → 'which', không dùng 'that'.

sentence: Employees should submit expense reports ____ a month.
explain: 'once a month' = mỗi tháng một lần.

sentence: The factory produces ____ 2,000 units per day.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho số lượng cần trạng từ 'approximately'.

sentence: Mr. Dubois is ____ for his attention to detail.
There ____ several complaints about the new parking policy.
The team worked ____ to finish the project ahead of schedule.
explain: 'work hard' = chăm chỉ. 'hardly' = hầu như không (nghĩa khác).

sentence: ____ the new regulations, all vehicles must be inspected annually.
She would rather ____ from home than commute two hours a day.
The auditor found ____ errors in the financial statements.
explain: 'errors' đếm được số nhiều → 'few'. 'little/much' đi với không đếm được.

sentence: The reception desk is staffed ____ the day and night.
Ms. Nakamura ____ as head of the department since January.
Please let us know ____ you will attend the banquet.
explain: 'let us know whether' = cho biết có … hay không.

sentence: The city council voted ____ the new bridge.
Customers can track ____ orders online at any time.
The elevator is ____ of order; please use the stairs.
Mr. Patel speaks Spanish ____ than anyone else on the team.
explain: Có 'than' → so sánh hơn của trạng từ: 'more fluently'.

sentence: The new policy will take effect ____ immediately.
explain: 'almost immediately' = gần như ngay lập tức.

sentence: ____ he is new to the company, Mr. Lim already leads a team.
The supplier ____ us a discount if we order in bulk.
explain: Điều kiện loại 1: 'if + hiện tại' → mệnh đề chính 'will give'.

sentence: The document must be signed by ____ the tenant and the landlord.
This offer is valid ____ 31 December only.
The training materials are available ____ from the HR portal.
explain: Bổ nghĩa cho 'available … from' cần trạng từ 'directly'.

sentence: Nobody ____ the office until the security check is complete.
The plant manager insisted that every worker ____ safety goggles.
explain: 'insist that + S + V nguyên mẫu' (giả định cách).

sentence: The survey results will be shared ____ all department heads.
____ of the applicants had the required certification.
explain: 'Most of the + danh từ'. 'Almost' là trạng từ, không đứng một mình.

sentence: The order was shipped ____ the customer requested express delivery.
explain: 'as soon as' = ngay khi; ship ngay khi khách yêu cầu.

sentence: We look forward to ____ you at the conference next month.
The manager wants the presentation ____ by noon tomorrow.
explain: 'want + O + V3' = muốn cái gì được hoàn thành.

sentence: ____ the CEO nor the CFO was available for comment.
The rent is due on the first day of ____ month.
explain: 'each month' với danh từ số ít.

sentence: Our sales representatives are trained ____ handle customer complaints.
The article was written ____ that even beginners could understand it.
Mr. Brown ____ retire next year after 30 years of service.
The room was too small ____ all the participants.
The company's profits have doubled ____ the last two years.
explain: 'over the last two years' = trong hai năm qua.

sentence: Ms. Wu was ____ to hear that her proposal had been accepted.
The safety manual explains ____ to operate the machine correctly.
explain: 'explain how to + V' = giải thích cách.

sentence: The new employee orientation will ____ at 9 a.m. in Room B.
Please ____ the enclosed questionnaire and return it by mail.
The company will ____ 50 new staff members next quarter.
All passengers must present a valid ____ at the boarding gate.
Ms. Garcia was ____ for her outstanding sales performance.
explain: 'be recognized for' = được ghi nhận/khen thưởng vì.

sentence: The hotel offers a complimentary ____ service to the airport.
Due to a scheduling ____, the meeting has been moved to Tuesday.
We need to ____ the budget before we can approve the project.
explain: 'review the budget' = xem xét lại ngân sách.

sentence: The printer is ____ with most operating systems.
Employees may ____ up to five days of unused vacation to next year.
The store's annual ____ sale starts on Friday.
Please ____ this email to anyone who might be interested.
The construction project is ____ to be completed by March.
The restaurant received a positive ____ in the local newspaper.
Our technicians are available to ____ any technical issues.
explain: 'resolve an issue' = giải quyết vấn đề.

sentence: The company aims to ____ its market share in Asia.
explain: 'expand market share' = mở rộng thị phần.

sentence: Tickets are non-refundable and must be used on the ____ date.
explain: 'the specified date' = ngày đã ghi rõ.

sentence: Ms. Osman will ____ the sales team while Mr. Lee is on leave.
The bank offers a competitive interest ____ on savings accounts.
Employees must ____ their supervisor if they will be late.
The hotel's ____ include a fitness center and a rooftop pool.
We were ____ with the quality of the catering service.
Please ____ a copy of your ID with the application form.
The delivery ____ depend on the size and weight of the package.
The manager gave a brief ____ of the new safety procedures.
The company car must be ____ to the garage by 6 p.m.
All complaints are handled ____ by our customer care team.
The meeting agenda was ____ to all participants yesterday.
The lease ____ that the tenant pay for utilities.
Because of a ____ of staff, the café closes early on Sundays.
The ____ for the design competition is 30 April.
Our products are ____ tested to ensure quality.
Mr. Silva has been ____ to the Tokyo office for two years.
explain: 'be assigned to' = được phân công tới.

sentence: Please keep your personal ____ in the lockers provided.
The seminar will ____ topics such as leadership and teamwork.
explain: 'cover a topic' = đề cập, bao gồm.

sentence: The new packaging is made from ____ materials.
A ____ of 20 percent is required to confirm the booking.
The consultant made several ____ to improve efficiency.
Sales have ____ by 8 percent since the advertising campaign began.
explain: 'rise' (nội động từ) → hiện tại hoàn thành 'have risen'. 'raise' cần tân ngữ.

sentence: The event was ____ due to unforeseen circumstances.
Ms. Kaur is highly ____ in international trade law.
Please ____ to the attached chart for detailed figures.
The factory has ____ strict quality-control measures.
The airline offers a 10 kg baggage ____ for economy passengers.
The road will be closed ____ while repairs are carried out.
The board ____ approved the merger last week.
Our new office is ____ located in the city center.
explain: 'centrally located' = nằm ở vị trí trung tâm.

sentence: Customers who are not satisfied may request a full ____.
The manager will ____ the new intern to the team this morning.
Please ____ that all windows are locked before leaving.
The company has a strong ____ for reliable service.
The keynote speaker will ____ the audience with a short video.
explain: 'address the audience' = phát biểu trước khán giả.

sentence: Employees are entitled ____ 15 days of paid leave per year.
The new smartphone features a ____ battery that lasts two days.
The quarterly ____ will be held in the main conference room.
The manager ____ the team on their successful product launch.
explain: 'congratulate someone on' = chúc mừng ai về.

sentence: Payment must be made within 30 days of the invoice ____.
The city has invested heavily in public ____.
Ms. Torres ____ a leading role in negotiating the contract.
explain: 'play a role in' = đóng vai trò.

sentence: The software update ____ several security problems.
explain: 'address a problem' = xử lý vấn đề.

sentence: The hotel restaurant is open to guests and the general ____.
Employees can ____ their timesheets through the online portal.
The fair will ____ over 200 exhibitors from 30 countries.
We ____ our valued customers for their continued support.
explain: 'thank someone for' = cảm ơn ai vì.

sentence: Owing to high ____, the seminar has been moved to a larger hall.
The company offers flexible working ____ to all employees.
explain: 'flexible working arrangements' = chế độ làm việc linh hoạt.

sentence: The auditor will ____ the accounts next week.
explain: 'examine the accounts' = kiểm tra sổ sách.

sentence: All electrical equipment must be ____ by a qualified technician.
The bakery is famous for its freshly ____ bread.
explain: 'freshly baked bread' = bánh mì mới nướng.

sentence: Please ____ the meeting minutes to everyone who attended.
